Role Title: QA Engineer – 2D & Creative Applications
 Role Type: Contractor
 Location: Remote
 micro1 is looking for QA Engineers with hands-on experience testing 2D design, animation, illustration, or other creative applications. You’ll use your QA and creative software expertise to evaluate real-world workflows and help improve the quality and reliability of AI systems.
 Scope of Work

• Test 2D and creative applications using real-world workflows.

• Identify bugs, usability issues, inconsistencies, and unexpected behavior.

• Create and execute test cases for different features and workflows.

• Reproduce issues and document clear steps, expected results, and actual results.

• Test edge cases and more complex workflows used by designers, illustrators, or animators.

• Provide clear feedback on application functionality and user experience.

• Work with the team to improve testing quality and coverage.

 Preferred Qualifications

• Professional experience in QA, software testing, or application testing.

• Hands-on experience testing 2D, design, animation, illustration, or other creative software.

• Familiarity with tools such as Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, Figma, Sketch, After Effects, Animate, or similar creative applications.

• Experience with manual and functional testing, test cases, and bug reporting.

• Strong attention to detail and ability to identify visual and functional issues.

• Good problem-solving and analytical skills.

• Clear written and verbal communication skills.
